Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Scrooge
Punchline: A gil saved is a gil earned.
Description: "You might say that everythin's for sale here in Ul'dah — as long as you've got the gil." — Momodi Modi
Changelog: Desynth tune-up. Skill-up colors now match the game exactly - including capped skills reading green, so a maxed class never inflates a melt score. Fish and furnishings join routing like any other desynthable, but only ever melt for a skill-up, never for material value. Stack desynths count every attempt in progress bars and totals ("2 selected - 7 desynths"). The sitrep gains a desynth skill readout for all eight classes. And when a skill-up outbids the market, the melt reason names the exact price it beat.

Author: DriftlessDigits
Name: Balamb Garden
Description: Gardening companion: stand by your garden and water, harvest, or replant a whole patch - or every ripe pot in the house - with one button, at a patient human pace. Keeps a ledger of what's planted where, when you watered it, and when it will be ripe (down to the afternoon). Tips watch your crossbreed pipelines and say when a chain is about to starve. /garden to open.
Changelog: Harvests count now: whether a button did the picking or you did, the window sees it and the pot reads empty right away - no more rows stuck saying ripe after the crop is in your bag. Ripe pots stopped nagging 'water now' (the game won't let you water a finished crop anyway). Water All and Tend All skip anything ripe or empty, so the rounds are quicker and the button counts only what it will actually touch. And walking into a house no longer flashes every pot amber while the game catches up.
